Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.  The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine  environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions. The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration strategy. Key Responsibilities  Infrastructure & Networking:  Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS  and Cloud NAT.  Linux System Administration:  Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues. VPN Management:  Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense  virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa  (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access. Performance Monitoring:  Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine  health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance. Resource Management:  Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene. Cost Optimization:  Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget. Database Oversight:  Provide support for PostgreSQL  and Oracle  environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem. Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter  Required Qualifications  Certification:  Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer  certification. Containerization Mastery:  Strong expertise with Docker  for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes. Scripting Mastery:  High proficiency in Python  or Bash  for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling. Networking Expertise:  Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense  and CloudConnexa.  Cloud Migration & Project Leadership:  Proven experience leading and running  application and data migrations from AWS  to GCP.  This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.  Compute Engine Mastery:  Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling. English Proficiency:  Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)  Nice-to-Have  PostgreSQL Expertise:  Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning. Oracle Expertise:  Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments. Data & Analytics:  Familiarity with BigQuery.   We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:

Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado. Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto. O pacote • Salário fixo: R$ 1.830 • Ajuda de custo: R$ 300 • Bônus mensal de até R$ 300 (por desempenho e comportamento) • Plano de saúde • Regime CLT, 100% remoto Total possível inicial: até R$ 2.430/mês + plano de saúde. Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos. A vaga em uma frase Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts. A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro. É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar. Como você vai trabalhar Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades. Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter: • Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição • Boa internet • Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado • Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você. O que estamos buscando Três coisas — em ordem de importância: 1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos. 2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço. 3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor. >>>Teste prático (Passo 1) Vídeo de explicação do teste:  A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo: • Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil) • Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil) • Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam? O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis). P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação. Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis): Vídeo 1:  Vídeo 2:  Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação. Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons. Critérios de avaliação: • Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia • Título / Headline escrito • Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait • Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir • Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples • Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído Referências de vídeos curtos:         >>>Como se candidatar (por e-mail) Envie o teste feito para:  •   •   Assunto: Vaga Editor de Vídeo Júnior — (Seu Nome)  Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo  Para quem essa vaga não é  • Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo • Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar • Quem reage a feedback como ataque • Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente Para quem essa vaga é  • Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido • Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar • Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Data Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About us:  Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn  Introduction:  We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation. Responsibilities:  Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.  **Please submit your CV in English. Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring  What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. Other Benefits:  Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy. Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Empresa está contratando Contract Review Attorney em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Headshots.com   At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth. We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting. About the Role   This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well. We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed. Key Responsibilities  Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue.  Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library.  Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.  What You Bring  Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements.  Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.   Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.  Why Join Us   Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies. IMPORTANT  Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. Compensation:  $40-60/hour depending on experience

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Empresa está contratando K-POP Influencers em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURFIZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion. We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position OverviewWe are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Requisitos essenciaisExperiência com rotinas administrativas e/ou controle de estoque/inventário. Facilidade com Excel/Google Sheets (nível intermediário para controle e atualização de dados). Organização, atenção a detalhes e disciplina para seguir processos e checklists. Capacidade de trabalhar com várias planilhas e sistemas ao mesmo tempo, sem se perder. Boa comunicação escrita para alinhar informações com o time. Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, 100% remoto, em período integral.  Diferenciais  Experiência com e-commerce ou marketplaces (ex.: Amazon). Familiaridade com ferramentas como ClickUp e Sellerboard. Job description:  About Us  Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches. Core Responsibilities  Image Retouching & Quality Control  Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images  Production & Workflow Discipline  Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards Apply feedback consistently and efficiently Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality  Core Skills Required  Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look) Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos) Realistic background compositing Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light Excellent time management and consistency at scale Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)  Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)  Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar) Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software) MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)  Volume, Timing & Pay  $5 USD per image Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days  Application Requirements (Read Carefully)  Apply by completing the test project:   Hiring Process  Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project Successful test submissions will be invited to interview Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed. Job Types: Full-time, Contract  IMPORTANT  All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.  O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?  Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.  Nosso Cliente  Esta oportunidade atenderá um importante grupo brasileiro do segmento industrial , com forte atuação nacional e foco contínuo em transformação digital, inovação e evolução de processos corporativos.  O projeto está inserido em um contexto estratégico, com atuação próxima às áreas de negócio e tecnologia, envolvendo iniciativas que exigem visão de produto, organização de demandas, capacidade de priorização e condução de times em ambientes ágeis e corporativos complexos.   O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho  Atuar como ponte estratégica entre negócio, stakeholders e times de tecnologia Definir visão de produto e apoiar a construção de roadmap e planejamento de entregas Criar, detalhar e priorizar itens do Product Backlog  garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio Traduzir necessidades e demandas em requisitos claros, estruturados e acionáveis para o time técnico Conduzir refinamentos de backlog, definição de critérios de aceite e acompanhamento das entregas Garantir organização, clareza e transparência das demandas junto às squads Apoiar a evolução contínua do produto através do acompanhamento de métricas, entregas e indicadores Atuar em ambientes ágeis, apoiando a fluidez e disciplina dos ritos Scrum  Facilitar cerimônias como Sprint Planning, Daily, Sprint Review e Retrospectivas  quando necessário Promover colaboração entre áreas e incentivar troca de conhecimento entre negócio e desenvolvimento   O que você precisa ter   Experiência consolidada atuando como Product Owner  em ambientes ágeis Vivência prática com Scrum  e atuação próxima a squads multidisciplinares Forte capacidade de priorização, organização e gestão de backlog Experiência na interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia Habilidade para conduzir alinhamentos com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes corporativos complexos Experiência com escrita de user stories , refinamento funcional e definição de critérios de aceite Capacidade de apoiar a organização e fluidez dos ritos ágeis do time   Será um destaque seu perfil com:  Inglês avançado  para interação em ambientes corporativos e alinhamentos com diferentes stakeholders Experiência prévia em projetos ou ambientes SAP  Certificações ágeis como CSPO, PSPO, CSM  ou similares Perfil colaborativo, com boa energia e facilidade para compartilhar conhecimento Capacidade de influenciar, engajar e gerar conexão entre áreas técnicas e de negócio Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e evolução de processos corporativos Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua   Onde você vai trabalhar?  Celebramos a troca, as relações e o poder do contato.  Modelo de trabalho híbrido , com atuação em Curitiba/PR  ou São Paulo/SP (Vila Leopoldina) . É necessário ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial de 3 a 4 vezes por semana  em uma dessas localidades. ⚠️ Importante:  embora a vaga possa aparecer como remota na plataforma, buscamos profissionais residentes na região ou com disponibilidade para mudança.

Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio. Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights). At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.  Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust  in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.  Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:

Apoiar na execução de janelas de manutenção e GMUDs, seguindo procedimentos padronizados e garantindo a comunicação com as áreas envolvidas; Realizar análises básicas em logs de aplicação e de sistema para identificação de causas prováveis e direcionamento adequado; Colaborar com times de Infra, Desenvolvimento e Suporte Aplicacional na investigação de incidentes e na implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de scripts, playbooks, checklists e automações de monitoração e operação; Participar da documentação de procedimentos operacionais, incluindo runbooks e FAQs para atendimento de primeiro nível; Apoiar testes e validações em ambientes de certificação/homologação quando necessário; Requisitos obrigatórios :  Experiência prévia em operações de TI, suporte técnico, infraestrutura ou NOC/Command Center; Conhecimentos básicos em sistemas operacionais (Linux e/ou Windows Server); Noções de redes (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, balanceamento, conectividade entre clientes e nuvem); Familiaridade com ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente OCI; experiência em AWS/Azure/GCP também é considerada); Experiência com ferramentas de monitoração (infra e/ou aplicação) e abertura/atualização de chamados; Conhecimento básico de SQL para consultas simples e análise de dados/logs; Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e registro de informações; Disponibilidade para atuação em regime de plantão, escalas e janelas de manutenção (incluindo horários noturnos e fins de semana, quando necessário); Diferenciais desejáveis:  Experiência em operações de ambientes SaaS e atendimento a clientes corporativos; Conhecimento em OCI (compartimentos, instâncias, VCN, storage, etc.); Vivência com ITIL (incidentes, problemas, mudanças); Experiência com ferramentas de automação e orquestração (por exemplo, Power Automate, scripts em Shell/PowerShell, etc.); Noções de observabilidade (logs centralizados, métricas, dashboards); Certificações em nuvem ou infraestrutura serão consideradas um plus.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:  Formação: Superior completo em tecnologia e afins Conhecimentos técnicos: Linguagem de programação para back-end (Node.js e TypeScript) – nível avançado;  Linguagem de programação para front-end (React) – nível avançado;  Fundamentos em frameworks de back-end (exemplo: NestJS, Spring, Express, Rails, outros) – nível avançado;  Fundamento em testes unitários - nível avançado;  Banco de Dados (Relacional e NoSql)– nível avançado;  Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software – desejável nível intermediário;  Arquitetura de Software (exemplo: cliente-servidor, web, outros) Experiência com segurança de aplicações e autenticação (OAuth2, JWT). Mentorar desenvolvedores Júnior e Pleno, além de influenciar decisões de negócio através da tecnologia; Vivência em projetos com filas Conhecimento em Serverless Conhecimento em AWS Vivência com uso de IA para geração de códigos  Requisitos desejáveis: Experiência com projetos usando (Spec-Driven Development) - (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Especificação) Conhecimento em CI/CD; Certificações AWS.  INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS  Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador; ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais; ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores; ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito; ● Plano de saúde e odontológico; ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação; ● Vale transporte; ● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida; ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário; ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida; ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada; ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar; ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead  to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do  Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution.  On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod.  Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed.  You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle.  You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are  You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if  You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if  You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location  Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. How to apply  To apply, please email  (not DM) the following directly to   and copy  :  Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned  In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery  We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.  O que oferecemos  Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)   Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time  About Uproot Clean  Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand. We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company. About the Role  This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment. Responsibilities  Active Sourcing  Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates  Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.  Candidate Outreach  Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow  Pipeline Management  Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting  What Success Looks Like  Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time  Requirements  Must Have  1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously   Strong Plus  Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools  Work Requirements  ⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST   Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)   Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required) Who This Role Is For (& Not For)  This Role Is For You If:  You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time  This Role Is NOT For You If:  You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only  Compensation & Benefits  Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction Fully remote : work from anywhere PTO : 2 Weeks Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:  one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.   Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.   Coaching credits:  $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development  Ready to Apply?  If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) • Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. • Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. • Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. • Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. • Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. • Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts. • Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations. • Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees. • Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled. • Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure. • Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region. Cash Management & Treasury Operations • Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies. • Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts. • Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations. • Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System. • Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations. • Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements. • Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories. • Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries. • Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts. • Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations. • Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience • Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees. • Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable. Technical Knowledge • Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds. • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements. • Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2). • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills. • Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure. • Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers. • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. • Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages • Advanced English (required). • Intermediate Spanish (desirable). Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização. Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:  ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor. ➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.). ➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um. ➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas. Arquitetura e Design da Solução:  ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.  Documentação e Apresentação:  ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.  Implementação e Operação:  ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.  Requisitos Diferenciais:  ➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição). ➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração. ➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução. ➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados. ➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas. ➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.  Conhecimentos Técnicos:  ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.  Habilidades : ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.  Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:  ➢ Proatividade ➢ Pensamento analítico ➢ Orientação a resultados ➢ Colaboração ➢ Adaptabilidade ➢ Aprendizado contínuo

You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

A posição exige perfil consultivo, visão sistêmica de supply chain, sólida experiência em processos de transporte rodoviário e forte entendimento operacional, fiscal e tecnológico envolvendo embarcadores, transportadoras e sistemas corporativos. Principais Responsabilidades  • Atuar em projetos de implantação de TMS/OTM, desde levantamento de requisitos até Go Live e estabilização. • Conduzir auditorias e conciliações de frete, validando divergências entre valores planejados e realizados. • Garantir aderência aos processos fiscais relacionados ao transporte rodoviário, incluindo CTe, SPED, NF-e e escrituração fiscal. • Realizar análise funcional de processos logísticos e de transporte em ambientes corporativos complexos. • Apoiar integrações entre TMS, ERP e demais sistemas satélites de supply chain. • Mapear regras de negócio relacionadas a frete, tarifação, conciliação e validação fiscal/financeira. • Atuar junto às áreas de logística, supply chain, fiscal, financeiro e tecnologia na resolução de inconsistências operacionais. • Participar de workshops, levantamento de requisitos, desenho de solução e validação funcional. • Apoiar homologações, testes integrados e validação de cenários críticos de transporte e faturamento. • Garantir rastreabilidade e consistência de dados logísticos e fiscais. • Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas à reforma tributária aplicada ao transporte e impactos sistêmicos nos processos de frete. Requisitos Obrigatórios  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em projetos relacionados a TMS/OTM. • Experiência comprovada com auditoria e conciliação de frete no Brasil. • Conhecimento sólido em CTe e legislação de transporte rodoviário. • Vivência em implantação de TMS em ciclo completo até Go Live. • Experiência em integração entre TMS e ERP. • Conhecimento em processos de supply chain e transporte rodoviário. • Experiência com embarcadores de grande porte ou consultorias de supply chain. • Conhecimento em processos fiscais relacionados a transporte: SPED  Nota Fiscal Eletrônica (NF-e) Escrituração fiscal Validação tributária de fretes • Experiência em análise de divergências entre dados planejados versus realizados com impactos financeiros e fiscais. • Capacidade de atuação consultiva junto às áreas de negócio e tecnologia. Diferenciais  • Experiência com Oracle Transportation Management (OTM). • Conhecimento em reforma tributária aplicada ao transporte e supply chain. • Vivência em projetos de transformação logística e digitalização de processos de transporte. • Conhecimento em indicadores logísticos, KPIs de transporte e gestão de custos logísticos. • Experiência em integração com SAP, Oracle ERP, TOTVS ou ERPs similares. • Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração e troca eletrônica de documentos fiscais/logísticos. • Vivência em ambientes com alto volume transacional de frete. Perfil Comportamental  • Perfil analítico e investigativo. • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal. • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e multifuncionais. • Organização e atenção a detalhes. • Visão sistêmica de processos logísticos e financeiros. • Capacidade de conduzir discussões funcionais e técnicas com diferentes áreas. • Proatividade e autonomia na condução de atividades. Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.
