We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy. The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash. Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together. Who we’re looking for  We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security. You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent. To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts. Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise. We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear. What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition  Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact.  Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination   Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.  Media pitching and spokesperson training   Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.  Strategic support and special projects  Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.  Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.  About you:  You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.  You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.  You think strategically and you can also get things done.  You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.  You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.  You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.  You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes.  You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.    Essential skills and experience  5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.  Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.  Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential.   What we offer  A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.  How to apply  Do not apply through LinkedIn.  Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

description:

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions   Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?  Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?  Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?  Can you type both fast and accurately?  Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income?  Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?  Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?  Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?  Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?  Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?   If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!   About California Labor Solutions  California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations. What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?  In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.  We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist. title: Lead Website Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Website Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Lead Website Designer  Location:  Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required Type:  Freelance About BX Studio  BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding. We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020. The Role  We’re looking for a Lead Designer to join our team on enterprise web projects for B2B and SaaS clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency. You’ll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time. This role is client-facing: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. We’re looking for someone proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong UX foundation and the experience to hit the ground running in a fast-paced agency environment. You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling. What You’ll Do  ● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality. ● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites. ● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability. ● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution. ● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project. ● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence. ● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each. ● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving. ● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life. ● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality. ● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects. What We’re Looking For  ● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities. ● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft. ● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow. ● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence. ● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences. ● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles. ● High proficiency in Figma required.; Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus. ● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred. ● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment. Why Join BX Studio?  ● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands. ● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities. ● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design. ● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

description:

O(a) Supervisor(a) de Limpeza é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar todas as operações diárias de limpeza em todo o campus escolar. Isso inclui salas de aula, banheiros, escritórios administrativos, áreas externas, instalações esportivas, espaços para eventos, áreas internas e externas.  O profissional atuará em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Facilities para implementar procedimentos de limpeza, responder às solicitações de serviço e garantir que todos os ambientes permaneçam limpos, seguros e acolhedores para alunos, colaboradores e toda a comunidade escolar. Realizar inspeções diárias em todos os prédios e áreas externas; manter registros de inspeção; priorizar áreas de grande circulação;  Identificar riscos como derramamentos, odores, entupimentos e comunicar às equipes responsáveis para ações corretivas.  Apoiar o processo de contratação de posições da empresa terceirizada de limpeza. Fornecer treinamentos relacionados aos procedimentos específicos da escola, padrões, rotinas e expectativas de segurança, garantindo que a empresa contratada realize todos os treinamentos técnicos sobre métodos de limpeza, uso de produtos químicos e padrões operacionais conforme seus protocolos internos.  Trabalhar em conjunto com o fornecedor para reforçar conformidade com EPIs, práticas de segurança e expectativas de desempenho.  Manter registros de estoque, assegurar armazenamento correto de produtos químicos, verificar rotulagem e procedimentos de diluição, identificar necessidades de manutenção preventiva e solicitar reposição antecipadamente.  Cumprir políticas da escola e regulamentações locais; desenvolver e atualizar POPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão);  Promover manuseio seguro de produtos químicos, diluição adequada e descarte seguro de resíduos.  Comunicar-se com colaboradores, liderança e outros departamentos para discutir necessidades de limpeza, tratar reclamações e preparar relatórios operacionais, desempenho da equipe e acompanhamentos.  Executar tarefas de limpeza quando necessário para cobrir ausências ou demandas urgentes;  Atuar como exemplo de procedimentos para a equipe.  Coordenar preparação e limpeza antes e depois de eventos, assembleias, reuniões e celebrações escolares;  Garantir que os espaços retornem às condições padrão.  Abrir chamados de manutenção para quaisquer problemas identificados, garantindo que tudo permaneça em condições ideais.  Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme designado pela administração.     #J-18808-Ljbffr
